new_value: {"description":"Double receipt persists. The \u003e=10 token threshold fix (commit 4fcda26) didn't help — both of OpenClaw's two calls per message generate substantial responses. OpenClaw runs a multi-step agent loop: initial context/planning call + final response. Both get receipts injected. Better fix needed: either (a) per-IP cooldown (skip receipt if another request came from same IP within last 5s), or (b) only inject receipt on the LAST SSE stream within a short time window, or (c) investigate if OpenClaw's pre-call can be identified by request shape (no user messages, or system-only) and skip receipt for those."}

Start Super on :8002 first (70 GiB), then start Nano on :8000 (32 GiB). Check nvidia-smi after both start. Expected: ~102 GiB used, ~17 GiB free for KV caches. Commands: Super: VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP4=0 VLLM_NVFP4_GEMM_BACKEND=marlin vllm serve nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4 --port 8002 --trust-remote-code --max-model-len 4096 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.60. Nano already on :8000. Check: gpuctl exec gb10-hackathon 'nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_gpu_memory --format=csv'","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"joey@neuralwatt.com","created_at":"2026-03-17T22:21:42Z","created_by":"Joey Thometz","updated_at":"2026-03-17T22:21:42Z"}

new_value: Not feasible with default settings. Nano FP8 at default utilization uses 110 GiB of 119 GiB available — only 9 GiB free, far less than Super's 70 GiB weights. Dual-model serving would require restarting Nano at --gpu-memory-utilization 0.35 (42 GiB) so Super can use the remaining 77 GiB. Feasible mathematically but risky for demo stability. Deferred in favor of freq cap approach (hackathon-foc).

{"id":"hackathon-dly.5","title":"Fix chat.inject: connect handshake fails silently, chat.inject rejected","description":"OpenClaw rejects chat.inject with 'invalid handshake: first request must be connect'. The _notify_openclaw() function sends connect then chat.inject, but connect response is not checked — likely an error (wrong scope, wrong token format, or connect response requires an ack). Fix: (1) log the connect response, (2) check for error in connect response before sending chat.inject. OpenClaw may require operator.admin scope — verify the token 439368c7ef3a54d50317db8d985c5b2829ab2e494ec24e26 has that scope. Also check: asyncio.run() in a daemon thread may not work cleanly — try using websocket-client (sync) instead of websockets (async).","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"joey@neuralwatt.com","created_at":"2026-03-17T22:26:20Z","created_by":"Joey Thometz","updated_at":"2026-03-17T22:26:20Z"}

new_value: Same fix as pxn.1 — per-IP cooldown commit 61348bf.
Fixed: per-IP 10s cooldown in proxy.py _stream_proxy(). Confirmed count=1 via curl grep test.
Fixed: added scope=operator.admin, check connect response, dedicated asyncio event loop. Commit 77a727b.

Validated. Baseline ~2398MHz: avg 46.66J, 1.28 tok/J. Capped ~988MHz: avg 21.34J, 2.84 tok/J. -54% energy, +122% tok/J. Idle power 10.97W → 5.28W (-52%). Proxy receipt faithfully reflects the difference. Viable for demo.
